panel.title: 1. Distribution : téléchargement d'exécutable puis rafale de requêtes (proxy)

search.query: index=proxy [search index=proxy file="*.exe" | dedup clientip | table clientip] | transaction maxspan=60s maxpause=5s clientip | where eventcount>10 | table _time clientip user eventcount duration
index=sysmon EventCode=1 | stats dc(host) AS nb_postes count AS lancements values(host) AS postes by Image sha1 | lookup sha1_lookup sha1 OUTPUT whitelisted_file | sort + nb_postes

panel.title: 2. Installation : programmes inscrits au démarrage (clé Run)

search.query: index=sysmon EventCode=13 TargetObject="*CurrentVersion*Run*" | stats count AS nb by host Image TargetObject Details

panel.title: 3. C&C : nombre de requêtes DNS par poste

search.query: index=dns | stats count AS Requests by clientip | sort - Requests

panel.title: 3. C&C : longueur des requêtes DNS (noms uniques)

search.query: index=dns | eval Length=len(query) | stats count AS requetes dc(query) AS uniques by Length | sort - uniques

panel.title: 3. C&C : trafic autorisé vers une adresse de la liste noire

search.query: index=firewall action=pass | lookup malicious clientip AS dst_ip OUTPUT threat ti_source | where threat!="clean" | stats count AS connexions sum(bytes) AS octets by src_ip dst_ip threat ti_source
index=wineventlog (EventCode=1102 OR EventCode=517) | table _time ComputerName Account_Name src_ip Message

panel.title: 4. Mission : ransomware (plus de 10 fichiers par minute)

search.query: index=sysmon EventCode=11 | bin _time span=1m | stats count AS nouveaux_fichiers by _time host Image sha1 | where nouveaux_fichiers>10 | lookup sha1_lookup sha1 OUTPUT whitelisted_file | sort - nouveaux_fichiers

index=loki | stats latest(_time) AS dernier_scan count(eval(level="ALERT")) AS alertes count(eval(level="WARNING")) AS warnings max(score) AS score_max by host | convert ctime(dernier_scan) | sort - score_max
